description: Creates a dataset metadata record in Fireworks (additive; actual data is uploaded separately). Control-plane: POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/datasets.

account_id.description: Fireworks account id. Overrides FIREWORKS_ACCOUNT_ID for this call.

datasetId.description: Id for the new dataset (the resource segment).

exampleCount.description: Number of examples in the dataset.

externalUrl.description: External source URL for the dataset data.

filter.description: Filter applied when deriving from a source dataset.

sourceDatasetId.description: Id of a source dataset to derive from.

name: fireworks_create_dataset
title: Create dataset
